notes.title: 📢 Update on Kukui: A Complete Remake in the Works! 📢
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We wanted to share some exciting news with you! As you know, Kukui has been around for a while, and after all this time, we've decided it's time for a fresh start. We’ve requested that Steam take down the original Kukui as we’re beginning a complete remake of the game from scratch. This isn't just a facelift—it’s a full overhaul with brand-new mechanics, features, and enhancements that will truly bring Kukui to life in a whole new way.

This remake is a big step for us, and we’re doing it to set the stage for what’s next: Kukui 3! We’re working hard to ensure that both the remake and the new game will be richer, deeper, and more engaging experiences for all of you.

We can’t wait to share more details and show you what’s coming. Thanks for being such a supportive community. Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for being part of this journey!

Much love,

- Yas

notes.title: Kukui 2 Update!
notes.content: Hello everyone! We've been getting a lot of requests to have a first-person camera and so we added one! We also implemented a chapter select screen so if there is a chapter that you would like to replay, now you don't need to replay the whole game again! We hope you enjoy the new changes.
